decisions.reason: After four years, demand uncertainty for this close but less distinctive schlager title should be largely resolved, so its remaining option value is low relative to the benefit of freeing attention and stock for stronger core releases.
This jazz vinyl reissue fits the firm's collector-oriented reissue capabilities and genre-broadening strategy well, and the cost of keeping it in the catalog is modest relative to its niche upside.
The multi-disc box set suits the firm's premium physical-media audience, so even with somewhat higher inventory commitment it still merits staying on the market unless sales deteriorate clearly.
As a low-commitment compilation CD close to the established catalog, it retains enough long-tail option value to keep available while tying up relatively limited resources.
